notes.title: Select Oblige is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Select Oblige is now available on Steam!  This release includes language options in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese, and supports Steam features like achievements and trading cards, along with a wealth of additional content.

[u]Frequently Asked Questions:[/u]

[b]Q: How do I switch between different language versions?[/b]
A: After launching the game, click on Config in the main menu to access Settings. In the lower right corner of the System page, you can switch between the Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and English versions.

[b]Q: How can I obtain additional content for this game?[/b]
A: Please refer to the Madosoft HP or VNDB for more information.

Select Oblige is the latest title from the popular Japanese visual novel brand Madosoft. It features character design and artwork by renowned illustrator Hiyo Yuzuna, with the story crafted by Shoukei Wakaba. The main heroines are voiced by well-known voice actresses Hana Akino, Kanau, Ren Sagami, and Yuuka Nanakusa. The theme song is performed by acclaimed singer Faylan.
